name: Red Barn Gardens
description: Red Barn Gardens grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 939 Williston Road, VT. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
